title: Akbar Administration The Mansabdari System
definition: A unique, integrated military-cum-civil administrative grading system introduced by Akbar (c. 1571) to organize the Mughal bureaucracy and military hierarchy, replacing the traditional iqta system.
importanceInUpsc: It is a perennial favorite for Prelims (conceptual mechanics) and Mains (administrative evolution, centralization, and socio-economic impact).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Akbar Administration The Mansabdari System.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic knowledge of the Iqta system
